prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A small ink glyph — a seed-like teardrop with two tiny outward-radiating
marks suggesting growth. Aurora cyan-green ink.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate, a single seed-glyph teardrop with two radiating growth marks, centered on aged parchment, punctuated by cool cyan-green against warm vellum cream.

subjects.description: Bold teardrop seed shape, two short outward-radiating strokes at crown, crisp nib-pen ink, reduced archival silhouette readable at smallest scale
Aged parchment ground, faint foxing at corners, warm vellum texture, generous negative space framing glyph
